text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My journey to take on the Twinkle Series
with
Special Week finally begins today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Full of enthusiasm, I head to the
cafeteria for
lunch, when...
choice_data_list: I'll make Spe's dream come true, no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! Hmm, I think I have space for a
little more.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Excuse meee! Another helping, please!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh, she wants more?! She's eating a literal ton of food! She's not just on another level, she's on another scale entirely!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
This is a disaster! Not only is the pantry

completely empty, the vegetables from
the
academy farm are gone too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems awfully noisy inside, and an
unusual
crowd is gathering.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wow... another one? She usually eats a
lot, but
this is a bit much.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Just watching her eat is giving me

heartburn.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What a sight to behold. You can barely
even see
her behind that mountain of
plates.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's getting bigger. It's like
we're at an
event! Nya-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look beyond the great pile of plates in
the
middle of everyone to find...
choice_data_list: (Just what the heck is going on...?)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Gulp! Hmmm, I've still got room for more!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Excuse meee! Two more helpings of this
dish,
please!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, hello Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sorry for startling you earlier!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I realized that our quest for the
Twinkle
Series started today...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't sit still! I could feel my
fighting
spirit burning up in my belly!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yup! I'm all fired up and ready to go!
choice_data_list: So that's why you ate so much...?
So that's why you were eating so much...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uh... Just saying, I-I'm totally gonna burn
all this
off in training!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna be carrying a lot of extra
weight
this early on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She'd need an absurd amount of training
to burn
all that off, but I decide not to
mention it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty, time to start our trai—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute! There's something I
wanted to
show you first!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yup!
choice_data_list: Something you want me to see?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Here. It's a letter to you from my mom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The letter is very politely written. It
expresses
gratitude for looking after
Special Week and asks
that I "help her
achieve her dreams."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I couldn't be prouder to call her my
mom!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I wanna be the top
Umamusume in
all of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For both my mom who raised me and my
mom
who gave birth to me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanna show them how much I've grown
and how
capable I've become! And I
wanna do so while
feeling proud!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Okay! First things first, we should focus
on my
debut!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's do this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, my journey with Special Week
as she
seeks to become the top
Umamusume in all of
Japan begins!
